ONE row per (repo, commit) episode - the INITIAL denial (earliest artifact/review), never the remediation rounds. The anchor resolves the git AUTHOR; rate = new findings / counted reviews, counted excluding no-parseable-count archive reviews (flagged no_count_line; they can deflate coverage, never a rate)
